title: Worksheet 9: The Adapter Pattern
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: The Adapter pattern lets two pieces of code work together even though they were built to connect in different ways, by placing a small translator, called an adapter, between them. A real-world example is a travel plug adapter: your laptop charger has a flat two-pin plug, but the wall in another country has round holes, so the adapter fits between them without changing either one. In programming, imagine a weather app that expects temperatures in Fahrenheit, but a new sensor library reports temperatures in Celsius. The programmer cannot edit the sensor library, and rewriting the app to use Celsius would mean fixing all 40 places in the app that use temperatures. Instead, she writes an adapter that takes each Celsius number from the sensor, converts it, and hands the Fahrenheit number to the app. For example, when the sensor reports 20, the adapter passes along 68.

questions.text: The Adapter pattern lets two pieces of code work together by:
questions.correct: Acting as a translator between them
distractors: Deleting the code that does not match

questions.text: In the plug example, what does the adapter fit between?
questions.correct: The laptop charger and the wall

questions.text: What unit of temperature does the weather app expect?
A second sensor library also reports Celsius numbers and also cannot be edited. Based on the paragraph, what is the best way to connect it to the app?
questions.correct: Write an adapter for it that converts Celsius to Fahrenheit
distractors: Rewrite the whole app to use Celsius
Edit the second sensor library's code
Ask the sensor to stop reporting numbers

questions.text: Which best explains why the adapter is a smarter choice than changing the app to use Celsius?
questions.correct: It fixes the mismatch in one place instead of the 40 places in the app that use temperatures
distractors: It lets the sensor report Fahrenheit directly
It makes the app stop showing temperatures
It removes the need for a sensor
